products.title: Timex® Quartz E Line 30mm Stainless Steel Bracelet Watch
products.body_html: Originally unleashed onto the scene in 1983, the E Line is a classic dress watch distinguished by a rounded square case shape affectionately dubbed the ‘TV Dial.’ For this tinier take inspired by the original, we’ve fitted it with a smaller 30mm stainless-steel case in the same iconic shape and powered it with a reliable quartz movement. Completing its smooth profile is a vintage-style flat mineral glass crystal, a pink sunray dial, and a brushed and polished stainless-steel bracelet with a butterfly clasp for a seamless look on the wrist.

products.title: Timex® Automatic E Line 38mm Stainless Steel Bracelet Watch
products.body_html: Originally unleashed onto the scene in 1983, the Timex Automatic E Line is a classic dress watch distinguished by a rounded square case shape affectionately dubbed the ‘TV Dial.’ For this fresh update inspired by the original reissue, we’ve fitted it with a more substantial 38mm stainless-steel case in the same iconic shape and brought a horizontal texture to the teal dial. Inside ticks a Miyota caliber 8215 Japanese automatic movement with 21 jewels that’s powered by your motion. Completing its smooth profile is a vintage-style flat mineral glass crystal, a date window seamlessly integrated into the dial at 3 o’clock, and a brushed stainless-steel bracelet with a butterfly clasp for a seamless look on the wrist.

products.title: Waterbury America 250 Table Clock 49mm Stainless Steel
products.body_html: Celebrate America’s 250th anniversary with a timepiece worthy of the occasion. This Waterbury-branded stainless-steel table clock shines with a sophisticated blend of brushed and polished finishes. Measuring approx. 49mm wide when closed, a simple press of the star-flanked button on the side opens the case to reveal the clock within. Once opened, the clock can be raised on its hinge to an angle of your choosing or stood upright for display at approx. 53mm tall, then gently lowered back into place to lie flat. A coin-edged bezel frames the white gloss dial, where full Roman numerals, a metallic blue handset, and a commemorative 250th anniversary logo create a beautiful, celebratory statement. Intricate guilloché detailing adorns both the front and back of the case, while a perlage-finished interior adds depth and texture, showcasing refined craftsmanship from every angle. To complete this commemorative design, the Waterbury logo is proudly displayed on the top of the case. It's a distinguished collectible honoring 250 years of American history, and as with any Timex, it has been crafted to be admired for years to come.

products.title: Waterbury Classic 40mm Leather Strap Watch
products.body_html: Meet the next generation of an ongoing classic. We traced back to our beginning in 1854 as the Waterbury Clock Company and found new ways to bring our heritage of craftsmanship and authetic watchmaking into the modern day. This watch features a meticulously stitched black natural leather strap, stainless-steel case and black dial that offers a wearing experience with ageless aesthetics.

products.title: Waterbury Classic 3 Hand 40mm Leather Strap Watch
products.body_html: We have looked to our past, and we’re paying homage to our original watch collection by using the Waterbury Watch Company logo on the dial and second hand, which bear the stylized W. Each watch displays our attention to craftsmanship and detail, with finely finished surfaces and careful applications of watchmaking ingenuity. Featuring a 40mm stainless-steel case, a black natural leather strap, a blue dial with Roman numerals, luminant hands, and a day and date window beside the 3 o’clock marker, our Waterbury Classic Day/Date unites all of these elements into something that’s right for your wrist today, and right for all the days to come.

products.title: Waterbury Classic 40mm Stainless Steel Bracelet Watch
products.body_html: We have looked to our past, and we’re paying homage to our original watch collection by using the Waterbury Watch Company logo on the dial and second hand, which bears the stylized W. products.title: Easy Reader® 35mm Leather Strap Watch
products.body_html: This classic design has been a favorite since 1977. With an easy-to-read white dial, a polished silver-tone or gold-tone 35mm case, a handy date window, and our revolutionary INDIGLO® backlight, this watch is as timeless as it is practical. We've updated its dapper aesthetic with a black leather strap complete with an enticing crocodile grain.

products.title: Weekender 31mm Fabric Strap Watch
products.body_html: Our most comfortable, versatile and effortlessly cool watch yet! These weekender essentials are designed with slip-thru straps, so you can easily change them depending on your outfit or mood. Go beyond the basics; have some fun; make a suit feel less stuffy; do the unexpected. Timex has a strap for every style.

products.title: Waterbury Classic 39mm Stainless Steel Bracelet Watch
products.body_html: A uniquely textured dial sets the tone on this update to our Waterbury Classic, featuring a pronounced handset in brilliant metallic blue, matching applied indices, and a sub-second dial at 6 o’clock. The 39mm stainless-steel case is fitted with a slightly domed mineral glass crystal and paired with a brushed and polished stainless-steel bracelet for a fully steel look that feels familiar yet new.

products.title: Easy Reader® Classic 38mm Leather Strap Watch
products.body_html: The direct descendant of our 1960's televised torture test survivors, today's Easy Reader is as durable as it is classically cool. We’ve updated the clean black or white dial to include both 12 and 24-hour time indexes, and we’ve included a handy date window besides 3 o’clock and our INDIGLO® back-light for easy time-telling in the dark. Complementing the 38mm gold-tone or silver-tone case is a brown or black natural leather strap that gives this easy, everyday timepiece a more traditional style.

products.title: Peanuts® x Timex Weekender In Bloom 38mm Fabric Strap Watch
products.body_html: A bouquet that stays! Celebrate the sweetness of spring year-round with our Peanuts Floral watch, featuring the 38mm silver-tone case construction of our beloved Timex Weekender. The comfortable fabric strap appears in a pretty shade of pink, while a smiling Snoopy on the bright white dial puts this watch in the running as one of our top picks. Plus, it even has our INDIGLO® backlight for easy time-telling at night.

products.title: Expedition Ridge Chronograph 42mm Silicone Strap Watch
products.body_html: Our 42mm Expedition North® Ridge Chronograph blends rugged design and sustainable materials with its hardwearing metal case and soft silicone strap. The ratcheting uni-directional top ring adds a sporty touch to the design. This watch is also equipped with luminescent hands and hour markers that make it easy to read the time in any lighting conditions, and quick-release spring bars so you can swap out the strap to suit your next adventure. Even better, 100M of water resistance means you can take this watch with you wherever you go, whether it's for a swim in the lake or a dive in the ocean.

products.title: Timex Legacy 34mm Stainless Steel Bracelet Watch
products.body_html: A fresh take on a traditional watch, the Timex Legacy never fails to find new ways of telling our story. This thoughtfully crafted timepiece features a two-tone 34mm case and coordinating stainless-steel bracelet with a natural mother-of-pearl dial that shimmers with your every movement. A testament to our heritage and well-suited for everyday wear, the dial offers gorgeous crystal accents, luminant hands, and a glittering Roman numeral marker at 12 o’clock.

products.title: Weekender 2-piece 40mm Leather Strap Watch
products.body_html: Interchangeable straps change your look in seconds. We’ve paired a favorite watch design with a rich tan two-piece stitched leather strap featuring quick-release functionality. Fits any 20mm traditional, slip-thru or quick-release strap.

products.title: Transit 33mm Resin Strap Watch
products.body_html: Powerful and feminine, the Ironman® Transit collection is everything you are. This watch is as practical as it is fashionable, with a sleek pink case, pink strap and a rose gold-tone top ring. Features include a countdown timer, sports stopwatch, customizable alarm and is water resistant up to 100 meters.

products.title: Easy Reader 35mm Leather Strap Watch
products.body_html: IT TAKES A LICKING AND KEEPS ON TICKING®. The direct descendant of our 1960's televised torture test survivors, today's Easy Reader® is as durable as it is classically cool.

products.title: Expedition Field Mini 26mm Leather Strap Watch
products.body_html: Our 26mm well-crafted field mini watch design gives you rugged metal construction, a green fabric strap with rich brown leather trim, INDIGLO® night-light and is water resistant up to 50 meters.

products.title: Peanuts® x Timex Expedition® Scout 40mm Silicone Strap Watch
products.body_html: With luminant hands and markers and a handy date window, this Peanuts watch ensures you'll be ready for any outdoor adventure. On the dial, you’ll find decorative cardinal markers and endearing artwork featuring your pal Snoopy on the trail. Perfect for hiking or camping with your troop, this watch pays homage to the incredible legacy of the Beagle Scouts and is finished with a grooved silicone strap for all-day comfort.

The lightweight resin case is equipped with a sturdy crown guard, and on the cream dial, you’ll find endearing artwork that’s sure to bring a smile to your face every time you check the time. products.title: Peanuts® x Timex Marlin® Jet Automatic Easy Rider 38mm Fabric Strap Watch
products.body_html: Born to ride, a sunglass-clad Snoopy revs his way across the silver-white dial of our retro-futuristic Marlin® Jet. Blue markers and a matching handset bring a cool pop of color to the dial, balanced perfectly by a blue slip-thru fabric strap that’s double-layered for durability. The dial also includes a handy date window, and it’s protected by a scratch-resistant domed Hesalite crystal that covers the entire top surface of the watch case, enveloping the grooved bezel bearing the Marlin name and bringing captivating depth to the watch's retro-futuristic appearance. Ticking inside the 38mm stainless-steel case is a battery-free automatic movement that’s powered by your motion and can be seen through an exhibition case back.
